note: The edge now proxies the API to videoflix-api, but videoflix-deploy still gives web the alias videoflix-web, so Caddy cannot resolve the upstream and answers 502 for /api/ only.

cause.title: refactor: name the videoflix upstreams after their service
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -78,7 +78,7 @@ jobs:
           set -Eeuo pipefail
           docker compose -f compose.yaml -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/compose.ci.yaml" up -d
-          docker run -d --name videoflix-web --hostname videoflix-web --network edge --network-alias videoflix-web "${STUB_IMAGE}" --port 8000
+          docker run -d --name videoflix-api --hostname videoflix-api --network edge --network-alias videoflix-api "${STUB_IMAGE}" --port 8000
           docker run -d --name videoflix-frontend --hostname videoflix-frontend --network edge --network-alias videoflix-frontend "${STUB_IMAGE}" --port 8080
@@ -136,9 +136,9 @@ jobs:
           videoflix=videoflix.philipp-klinger.com
-          expect "${videoflix}" GET /api/health/ 200 videoflix-web
-          expect "${videoflix}" GET /admin/ 200 videoflix-web
-          expect "${videoflix}" GET /static/app.css 200 videoflix-web
+          expect "${videoflix}" GET /api/health/ 200 videoflix-api
+          expect "${videoflix}" GET /admin/ 200 videoflix-api
+          expect "${videoflix}" GET /static/app.css 200 videoflix-api
           expect "${videoflix}" GET / 200 videoflix-frontend
diff --git a/sites/videoflix.caddy b/sites/videoflix.caddy
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ videoflix.philipp-klinger.com {
 			max_size 55MB
 		}
 		# Caddy sets X-Forwarded-For to the client address (TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT=1 in Django)
-		reverse_proxy videoflix-web:8000
+		reverse_proxy videoflix-api:8000
 	}
 
 	handle {
